content: This information is not intended to serve as personalized medical advice and should not replace the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. Side Effects: Vaginal or urethral burning, itching, or pain, as well as lower abdominal cramps, may occur. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. This is not an exhaustive list of possible side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. In Canada, contact your doctor for medical advice about side effects. Precautions: Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other azole antifungal agents (e.g., terconazole, fluconazole), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Ask your doctor whether sexual intercourse is safe while using this product. This product may weaken rubber-based products (e.g., latex condoms, diaphragms, cervical caps), potentially leading to failure and resulting in pregnancy. Do not use these products during treatment with this medication. Do not use this medication for self-treatment if you are pregnant. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. If you are pregnant, follow your doctor’s instructions on how to use the applicator to insert this medication. It is unknown whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug Interactions: Drug interactions may alter how your medications work or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use (including prescription, non-prescription drugs, and herbal products) and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. Overdose: This medication may be harmful if swallowed. If someone has overdosed and exhibits serious symptoms such as passing out or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. Prevention of Vaginal Yeast Infections: Thoroughly dry the genital area after showering, bathing, or swimming. Avoid wearing tight jeans, nylon underwear, pantyhose, wet bathing suits, or damp/sweaty exercise clothes for extended periods. Missed Dose: If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of the next dose, skip the missed dose and use your next dose at the regular time. Storage: Store this medication at room temperature. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. Important Notes: This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
